newsitem.title: INDIA: India May crude output 2.87 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: India May crude output 2.87 mln tonnes.

text.p: India produced 2.87 million tonnes of crude oil in May compared with 2.80 million in the same month last year, the Petroleum Ministry said on Thursday.
India produced 5.68 million tonnes of crude oil during April and May compared with 5.56 million tonnes in the same period in 1996, the ministry said in a statement.
Refinery throughput was 5.57 million tonnes in May compared with 5.22 million in the same month last year, it said.
The cumulative refinery output during April and May was 10.79 million tonnes against 10.34 million in the same period last year, the statement said.
The ministry said the country's overall natural gas supplies in May totalled 1,618 million cubic metres compared with 1,570 million in the same month last year.
Cumulative April-May supplies stood at 3,202 milion cubic metres compared with 3,058 million in the same months of the previous year.
